description: This file defines the SkillsManager class responsible for discovering, loading, and managing skill metadata from filesystem directories, including handling symlinks, mode-specific skills, and file watching for updates. It interacts with VSCode APIs and external modules to facilitate skill management in a VSCode extension environment.

classes.name: SkillsManager
classes.description: Manages discovery, loading, and watching of skill metadata, including handling symlinks, mode-specific skills, and notifying configuration changes.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the SkillsManager by discovering skills and setting up file watchers.

methods.name: discoverSkills
methods.description: Discovers all skills from global and project directories, supporting symlinks and mode-specific directories.

methods.name: scanSkillsDirectory
methods.description: Scans a directory for skill subdirectories, resolving symlinks.

methods.name: loadSkillMetadata
methods.description: Loads skill metadata from a SKILL.md file, validating fields and storing in the skills map.

methods.name: getSkillsForMode
methods.description: Returns skills applicable for the current mode, resolving overrides.

methods.name: shouldOverrideSkill
methods.description: Determines if a new skill overrides an existing one based on source and mode.

methods.name: getSkillContent
methods.description: Retrieves the content of a skill by name, considering mode-specific overrides.

methods.name: getSkillsDirectories
methods.description: Returns directories to scan for skills, including mode-specific directories.

methods.name: getAvailableModes
methods.description: Retrieves list of available modes, including custom modes.

methods.name: getSkillKey
methods.description: Generates a unique key for a skill based on name, source, and mode.

methods.name: setupFileWatchers
methods.description: Sets up filesystem watchers on skill directories to detect changes.

methods.name: watchDirectory
methods.description: Creates a watcher on a directory to trigger rescanning on changes.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of watchers and clears internal state.
